pearlText: Craving isn’t hunger. It’s a story about what will finally be enough.
You don’t rise above a feeling. You go all the way through it.
Confusion is just contact with something you haven’t named yet.
The Three Poisons, in one breath: wanting, resisting, not seeing clearly.
Nothing pleasant lasts — and that’s not the tragedy you think it is.
Equanimity isn’t distance. It’s presence without a grip.
Aversion is craving wearing a different coat.
The eight worldly winds blow through everyone. You don’t have to sail by them.
Feeling-tone comes first. The story comes after — and it’s optional.
You can’t think your way out of a feeling. You can only meet it.
Suffering isn’t the event. It’s the second arrow you fire at yourself.
Awareness doesn’t fix the weather. It’s the sky it happens in.
